description: Get company-stated operational and non-GAAP KPIs extracted from written 8-K earnings releases and 10-K/10-Q MD&A, with period, filing date, source quote and exactly comparable year-over-year change. Omit metric for each series' latest reading; pass a company metric label for its full history. Values retain the company's stated scale. Earnings-call transcripts are not figure sources. A disclosed GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation includes its stated bridge.

metric.description: Optional metric name to expand into its full history (e.g., 'subscribers', 'Adjusted EBITDA'). Matches the company's own metric labels case-insensitively; when the name matches several metrics the tool lists those candidates. Omit for the overview of every metric's latest reading.

name: GetCompanyKpis
title: Company KPIs
